name: Love & Hauntings
source:
As you arrive in New Zealand, your mind is overwhelmed with conflicting thoughts. You hear voices in your head – and outside your head, too. Which voice will you heed?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当你抵达新西兰时，你的脑海中充满了相互矛盾的想法。你会听到头脑中的声音，也会听到头脑外的声音。你会留意哪个声音？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
